title: Abner Breaks with Ish-bosheth and Makes a Covenant with David
description: Abner strengthens his position in Saul's house, but becomes furious when Ish-bosheth accuses him of having gone to Saul's concubine Rizpah. He swears to transfer the kingdom to David and sends word of a covenant. David demands that Michal, his former wife, be brought back, and Ish-bosheth takes her from Paltiel, who follows her weeping to Bahurim before Abner sends him back. Abner then negotiates with the elders of Israel and the house of Benjamin, and afterward goes to Hebron where David holds a feast for him. Abner is allowed to leave in peace to gather all Israel into covenant with David.
